parent_objective: design a low-margin boundary-window retargeting step after M801 diagnostic-band-only result

public_gates: M803 designs only; it does not implement or run a new wave
M803 preserves the P0 human-view actor contract
M803 targets the M801 collision/success boundary window
M803 keeps the primary <=0.00005 margin gate unchanged
M803 blocks residual calibration, PPO, and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not implement the retargeting tool
do not run another source wave
do not widen the primary low-margin threshold
do not treat alpha scan results as deployable actor inputs
do not use private holdout feedback for public retargeting

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: moves from broad coverage positive but primary low-margin negative to targeted collision/success boundary retargeting
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no implementation training PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if design relaxes the primary margin gate instead of retargeting
stop if design only increases seed count without using M801 boundary evidence
stop if design depends on oracle deploy-time inputs
stop if design admits calibration before source-diverse low-margin rows exist
fallback_plan: if boundary-window retargeting is infeasible, write a branch synthesis before changing the guard definition
if transition rows are too concentrated, add source caps and targeted scenario-axis diversification
if tooling would be long-running, add progress/sharded execution to the implementation design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M802 audits M801 as a clean diagnostic-band-only boundary-window miss

hypothesis: A targeted boundary-window retargeting design can convert M801's collision rows and nearest safe diagnostic rows into a source-diverse primary low-margin mining plan without relaxing the margin gate.
success_criteria: M803 documents a design for boundary-window retargeting
M803 specifies which M801 collision and safe diagnostic rows seed the retargeting
M803 specifies controllable public scenario axes and acceptance gates
M803 keeps the primary low-margin threshold unchanged
M803 keeps residual calibration, PPO, and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: design weakens the primary low-margin threshold
design admits training, PPO, or promotion
design ignores source diversity and long-run progress/sharding requirements
decision_rule: M803 may only design boundary-window retargeting. It must not implement, run waves, train parameters, run PPO, or promote a checkpoint.
